intervals.label: hosting DANSS
intervals.note: Interval of the particle-physics use only; the plant itself (four VVER-1000 units) is much older and its commissioning dates were not sourced here. No official plant page was reachable.
intervals.quote: The DANSS experiment [33,34] has been operated since 2016 at a LEU reactor of 3.1 GW thermal power in Kalinin, Russia

name: Kalinin Nuclear Power Plant
notes: Plant described in the DANSS detector paper: "Kalinin Nuclear Power Plant (KNPP) located between Moscow and Saint Petersburg and exploiting four pressurized water reactors WWER-1000".

summary.plain: A Russian nuclear power plant between Moscow and Saint Petersburg with four large pressurised-water reactors; under one of them the DANSS experiment has been catching antineutrinos since 2016.
summary.technical: Kalinin Nuclear Power Plant (KNPP), Udomlya, Tver Oblast, Russia: four VVER-1000 pressurised-water reactors (units 1-2 of project B-338, units 3-4 of project B-320), 3.1 GW thermal power per unit; host of the DANSS antineutrino spectrometer.
